paragraphs: R' Yannai, son of R' Shmuel.

Mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah chapter 1, at the supplied verse marker ג״א. Midrash Shmuel 21:3 has R' Yannai bar Shmuel bar Yannai. Hyman gives the reading in Vayikra Rabbah 21:2 as R' Yannai in the name of R' Shmuel bar Yannai and reports the same reading in Pesikta de-Rav Kahana at the supplied locator 175.

notes.text: The verse marker ג״א is unresolved; it is not a warrant for “verse 3, section 1.” The three-generation patronymic and the alternative report chain remain distinct.

The consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:1 calls the speaker Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Shimon. Midrash Shmuel 21:3 gives Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Shmuel son of Rabbi Yannai. For the parallel about Goliath, both Vayikra Rabbah 21:2 and Buber’s Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, folio 175 (Acharei Mot), have Rabbi Yannai reporting in the name of Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yannai, where Hyman gives Shmuel. Buber’s note also cites the different wording in Midrash Shmuel.
